Marianette Miller-Meeks is not the Representative-elect from Iowa 2. Although results for the race have been certified, Rita Hart is contesting the results under the Federal Contested Elections Act, due to the extremely close margin, 0.002%, or 6 votes, allowing the House to decide the winner under the authority given to it by the Constitution. Once the Democratic-majority House picks a winner, then that person is Rep-elect.
Please, do to the RFC at [[117th United States Congress]]
